name: beast
label: Beast
notes: BACKUP of the configuration 737 recorded rounds were played with, read off
dataset/*/samples.jsonl rather than retyped, so it is what actually ran.
Covers builds 1.11.1e through 1.11.7b; the tunables never differed between
them. Machine-specific options (dataset path, duration, emulator geometry)
are deliberately NOT here -- a profile is about the tsum, not the machine.
Measured on this tsum: base colour covers 14.2% of the board, the base
preference fires on 17.4% of drags, 24.0% of frames match the icon weakly,
FEVER share 0.45, skill fires 2.25 times a round.
